notes.title: Pink Magical Dust, and Favors Update.
notes.content:
Update Changes

Favor update is live i know you all were having issues with favors and we had to find a way to keep it balanced. We came up with a system for balance and fair rates. 

You will get the following favors based on age :

1 - Young
2 - Young Adult
4 -Adult
8 - Mature
16 -Elder
32 - Counselor
64 - Methuselah
128 - River
256 - Obelisk
512 - Tectonic
1024 - Nephilim
2048 - Divine
4096 - Celestial
8192 - Goddess


Black Dust is now Pink Dust
Any new drops will be "Pink" and existing black is converted when equiped to Pink dusts. 


Silverdust Changes / Balances
Shock / Thunder damage is now capped to damage done. 
*Example :kissing: if you did 2,000 damage your silver dust damage will cap to 2,000. 


Weapon Mastery cap

Geo and Tower Moving Sentinels / Boss Changes
Rabbit, Spirit, Butterfly, Orc, etc. Will not move now.

notes.title: My Bloody Valentine. Update 2.76
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Sorry of the 6 months of no new updates, We here at blade Mistress have been working hard on balances, hotfixs, new or improved mechanics. 

So lets get started with a major change, Client version update, 2.75 no longer we are 2.76, With this brings new changes and abilities from the back end for us to improve and add. 

Starting with Test Server : 
- PvP
- PvP Realm
- New Dust
- Favor Balance and Tweaks
- Gold Dust properly Fixed
- Storm Monster Loot overhauld
- Back end changes for Admins.

PvP Dust is based on Clvl, to dust. You can not strike a level 60 with only 10 New Dusts, PvP can only be done in the new realm located by walked into the tower of infinite, Walk into it like you would a guild tower. Located at  135, 94.



Main Release Updates and News : 

On Feburary 13th to the 17th Love is invading our world during this event you can gain lots of dust, and unique common loot that you will not be able to get until next Valntines. 

IF testing goes well The new Dust will drop from the hearts and will be earned differently after the event.

notes.title: 1.0.7 Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Quality of life changes :

- Added help UI to help new players learn. Use the help button in the bottom right!

- Fixed text with Windows app scaling.

- Kill quests can support multiple subtypes.

- Silver Dust quest allows all lizards besides pewny.

- Clvl from Totem Shatter increased.



Event Changes :

- Storm creature loot reworked.

- Storms now show how many storm creatures have spawned.



Major Fixes : 

- Significant improvement with antivirus false flags. 

- Some file sizes reduced. No more unicorn lag!

- Fixed go to location quests being able to target towers/dungeons.

notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.content:
Features 

•    Mages get increased drake attack speed per age, similar to fighters

•    Staves now require natural magic stat to wield, depending on the tier of staff and whether it’s din or not
           -Spirit summoning staves have no magic requirement

•    Added scythe mastery

•    Added a gold dust visual

•    Adjusted the dust/shard visuals for scythes

•    Tamed bunnies now have a special attack that should make them a strong option for single target damage. 

•    Added Community Merchant in Fingle
            -Has no base stock, and stock does not deplete. A fun place to sell extra items or scope out what other people have sold and scoop up anything you find useful! 




Balance Changes

•    Buffed maces
           -Chaos is still higher total DPS over time, but the gap is much smaller than before. You can decide if you want the higher but unreliable dps of a chaos, or lower but steady dps of a mace. This will apply retroactively to existing maces as well.




Changes 

•    Tower of Infinity no longer has a chest, and no longer gives keys to the next floor
            -The portal at the end of the floor will now teleport EVERYONE on the floor to the next floor.

•    Tower of Infinity now has a stronger boss every 10th floor

•    Adjusted the difficulty on most bosses




FIXES

•    Fixed an issue with extra data in the quest list packet (for reals this time)

•    Fixed an issue preventing beastmasters from gaining additional beast stat with age
            -Any wrong stats from this will be fixed retroactively on login

•    Fixed an issue preventing beastmasters from gaining clvl from pet mastery
            -Clvl would recalculate on login, but will now properly grant clvl upon leveling

•    Reworked mouse input as it was found to be a major source of false antivirus flags due to using deprecated libraries

notes.title: Update 1.0.6 Hotfixes
notes.content:
New Features : 

• Updated launcher now handles both servers (normal, test) and both graphics (updated, classic)



New In-Game Features :

• Added staff mastery



In-game Tweaks : 

• Staff damage is displayed on hit if enabled

• Mastery skills now give clvl

• Clvls from magics slightly adjusted (0.3 -> 0.4) 3 levels in a magic is 1 clvl

• General chat is now on by default for new players

• Removed unicorns and event monsters from kill quests.

• The extended info text for weapons will now display accurate damage 

• Adjusted stock on Merchant-in-a-Bra for bomb mats to be more in line with the other items sold

• Vagabond exploit fixed (Thanks Iresh!)

• Fixed memory leak reported by MHRyder

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
Update 1.0.6

• Added quest list in a draggable window, press Q to open, drag it via the top bar

• Bombs now hit the full visible range, but damage falls off faster leading to slightly less overall damage

• Bombs now stack regardless of stability
 
• Bosses and Invasions are now immune to bombs

• Gold cap has been raised significantly 2.1billion to 9.7Quatillion.

• Geo walls are reduced starting at 30m
    
We understand many of you were hoping for no geo walls, however the giant empty geos felt weird and out of place

Walls will start reducing at 30m, and every 10m will have less walls capping at 200m
200m+ will have very few walls, enough that it doesn't feel weird and barren, but it's open enough that the walls aren't really going to get in your way

• New ages added. Names and Clvls.
-Obelisk : ||5.110||
-Tectonic : ||10,230||
-Nephilim : ||20,470||
-Divine : ||40,950||
-Celestial : ||81,910||
-Goddess : ||163,830||

• Butterflies tweaked - stronger stats, less drops, longer respawns
These tweaks should make them feel like they're the strongest bosses in the game

• Orc camps nerfed - slower respawn, less drops
Orc camps being easily accessible and fully afk were giving far too much gold. This nerf is to encourage active play like deep geos.
~78% less gold/hr for an optimal fighter
~66% less gold/hr for bm using wildfire

• Tower of Infinity drops have been dramatically increased
Sentinels will drop between 1:floor drops. A floor 20 sent can drop anywhere from 1 to 20 drops. Despite walls being adjusted in geos, they're unchanged in tower!

• Tower of Infinity sentinels now have some hp regen

• Bot detection

BUG FIXES :
• Clicking chat box will no longer change inventory filters
• Fixed an issue with Geomancy
• BM pets will no longer try to kill each other
• New players no longer have negative HP
• Stat totems are no longer silently capped at 127
• Added button to the options menu to reset filter flags

notes.title: Test Server Opening.
notes.content:
Join in the Test Server, to try out features find what you can break. 


What this build adds in some new qaulity of life and bug fixing along with previous poll mentions.

- Increased max cash 
(Test the heck of out this. Buy stuff, sell stuff, trade each other, stash it away, We are looking for negative values in the ui. You'll start with 100 billion to play with.)

- Quest list UI (Press Q!) You may also move this, Surprise new feature.

- Geo walls removed after 30m

- Bombs stack regardless of stability, and Bomb range adjusted to hit all visible enemies (damage balancing to account for this is work in progress)

Be aware that as things get pushed to the test server, you may get a message saying your client is out of date. If that happens, just hit update on the launcher with the test server selected!
